title: SignalCommand
description: DRAFT v0.1.0. Requested next green phase for one intersection. Path: ai/ (Demir Cücü) -> backend/ (Ario Bashiri) -> ESP32 relay board (hardware/, Tolga Uçar). This is a REQUEST: the hardware green-conflict interlock and the 1000 ms watchdog (flashing-yellow fallback) remain authoritative and may reject or override it. Safety limits are encoded as bounds: green 10-60 s, yellow 3 s, all-red 1 s.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing per intersection; receivers drop out-of-order commands.

mode.description: fallback_webster = local adaptive Webster mode used when the network/central link or the MARL policy fails.

phase_id.description: Green phase id from the intersection's phase plan. Phase plans per intersection: TBD (Öykü + Tolga).

valid_for_ms.description: Command expiry. After expiry without a new command the controller keeps its local plan.

emergency_request_id.description: Set when issuer = emergency_preemption or mode = recovery.
